future_check: Require canonical-pair parity whenever archival text differs, and quarantine if either execution parity or source-role metadata disappears.
rationale: Its role is explicitly archival/executable, not selected. Keeping it preserves provenance, but future tooling must remain role-aware and must not interpret the second text group as active semantic divergence.
summary: The archival raw Racket source remains textually different from the selected rule.

future_check: If new canonical authority expands the grammar, add explicit lawful branches and output-shape tests rather than loosening self_check globally.
rationale: The selected oracle accepts density >=0.9 and emits whatever group lengths it finds, while the teaching distribution intentionally uses solid targets and exactly three columns to match all canonical outputs and keep lessons well-formed.
summary: Watch for private-task variants with non-solid qualifying components or more than three rectangles in a spatial row.

future_check: Recheck component-count and component-size tails after any noise-density or placement change, not only exact cell count.
rationale: A first repair draft satisfied semantic predicates but produced an unrealistically high singleton-component count. The strict defect detector caught this against canonical object-count support. Uniformly sampled occupied noise cells with independent two-color labels retain exact noise_count while matching the canonical component envelope.
summary: Generate dense irregular two-color noise instead of checkerboard singleton speckles.

future_check: At intake, apply the canonical and task-local selected-source edits atomically, then rerun selected exact sync plus archival execution parity.
rationale: Canonical program_solution and selected target_code are the active rule authorities and must match. The older raw_code is useful executable search history, so it remains archival rather than being rewritten or misclassified as another selected candidate.
summary: Synchronize active selected sources exactly while preserving role-stated archival raw_code.

future_check: Add any new shortcut to SEMANTIC_RIVALS and require a nonzero disagreement count in every sufficiently powered census.
rationale: All are plausible from subsets of the canonical examples or from generic frequency/shape cues. The three-slot curriculum and palette scheduling make each rival observably wrong without changing the intended rule.
summary: Reject sorted-color, frequency-echo, fixed-two-row, and column-major shortcuts with generated counterexamples.

future_check: When adding an axis, require ordinary-draw GenCtx provenance to equal observe_overrides on at least 200 returned draws per band before expanding the domain.
rationale: The baseline declared nine axes, but several were dead, singleton, unrecorded, or not recoverable from returned pixels. The replacement axes directly describe output height, rectangle-size variation, target-color relation, and exact noise-cell count.
summary: Use only four exact pixel-observable axes and schedule three of them across every three-example lesson.
